headline: Liverpool's Andoni Iraola admits Bournemouth will be aware of his tactics ahead of 'tricky' return
description: Andoni Iraola is looking forward to returning to Bournemouth with Liverpool -- even if the opponents may understand his methods better than his own players.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal's Madueke eyed by Premier League rivals
description: Noni Madueke could leave for one of Arsenal's Premier League rivals in January in a search for more playing time. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Brentford upset Chelsea in historic win at home
description: Brentford record a home win against Chelsea for the first time since 1938, as they cruise to a 3-0 win over the Blues at Gtech Community Stadium.

headline: Xabi Alonso joins unwanted managerial group after heavy Brentford defeat
description: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso joined an unenvied group of managers on Friday night as his side continued their poor defensive start to the Premier League campaign with a 3-0 defeat at Brentford.

headline: Arsenal, Mikel Arteta open to Max Dowman loan move
description: Arsenal are "open" to allowing teen sensation Max Dowman to leave the club on loan if he does not play enough matches.

headline: Xabi Alonso says Chelsea were 'out of control' in Brentford loss
description: Xabi Alonso said his Chelsea team lost control against Brentford in their 3-0 defeat on Friday evening and agreed with Levi Colwill that his side were bullied in set pieces.
